note: Grounded repaint v3 2026-10-21: close view of the cellar's back tasting bar. One flagstone floor; the knight's armour, the pickers and the gentleman's stool stand on it, the bartender works behind the counter, small objects (and the mouse and parrot) sit on the counter top at true scale. No shelf-perched figures. All ten words are masculine, so everything is right of the divider.

items.label: le vignoble
items.scene: A NOBLE knight with a big V on his shield (vee-NYOBL) stands guard beside a painting of his hillside VINEYARD.

items.label: le whisky
items.scene: Same as English 'whisky' but said wees-KEE: the WHISKY bottle on the bar wears a big brass KEY on a tartan ribbon: whis-KEY!

items.label: le cigare
items.scene: Same as English 'cigar' but said see-GAHR: beside the cedar box with its fat CIGAR a tiny red toy CAR is parked: SEE the CAR!

items.label: le champagne
items.scene: Same as English 'champagne' (said shahn-PAHNY): the bartender pops the CHAMPAGNE and catches the gushing foam in a frying PAN: sham-PAN!

items.label: le rhum
items.scene: Like English 'rum' but said ROM: a parrot perched on a little RUM barrel squawks 'ROM! ROM!'

items.label: le cognac
items.scene: Same as English 'cognac' (said koh-NYAHK): a round balloon glass of amber COGNAC glows beside a candle on the bar.

items.label: le tire-bouchon
items.scene: Literally 'pull-cork' (teer-boo-SHOHN): a little mouse leans back and TUGS a CORKSCREW until the cork pops free.

items.label: le cidre
items.scene: Like English 'cider' but said SEEDR: beside the CIDER bottle an apple cut in half shows its SEEDS.

items.label: le gourmet
items.scene: Same as English 'gourmet' (said goor-MEH): a plump GOURMET, napkin tucked in, sniffs a wedge of blue cheese with closed eyes.

items.label: le cru
items.scene: A CREW (KREW) of three grape-pickers with baskets on their backs proudly holds up bottles of their famous VINTAGE.
